uses.scope: All existing 23 Eastern research slots; the list of IDs records the research question, not a current canonical census.
uses.finding: No competent current full named Eastern Catholic enumeration was obtained in this new bounded public-source pass.

uses.disposition: Remain unresolved. Southern Albania territorial administration, an appointment, a geographic label, an Italo-Albanian reference, omission or a total without names does not supply this classification.

official_annuario_faq.paraphrase: The service identifies its data as official and maintained by the Ufficio Centrale di Statistica, requires registration and subscription for full contents, offers neither demo nor free trial, does not provide data export, and states limited use/reproduction terms. These are current public service statements, not an independently inspected current Church enumeration.
checked_sections: Registration and subscription requirement for full contents
Lack of demonstration access or free trial
Official data and the maintaining Statistics Office

new_evidence.annuario_public_scope: The newly captured public welcome, overview and FAQ pages contain no named Eastern Church enumeration. The complete public client was inspected for category/access context; technical route labels are not treated as a canonical taxonomy or as evidence about subscriber data.
new_evidence.annuario_clock_and_authority_limit: The public FAQ identifies official data maintained by the Ufficio Centrale di Statistica and states access conditions. These undated service statements were observed on the task civil date; they are not an independently inspected 2026 Church list. A client route name and a Unicode Caucasian_Albanian token are not Church classification evidence.

new_evidence.italian_extract_reuse_limit: The offered 101-page Italian Jubilee extract matches a previously deferred exact SHA. Its Rome-specific chapter and copyright reservation were already bounded in the earlier research. This batch adds a route recheck and focused inspection; it does not claim discovery of a new source object or global enumeration.
new_evidence.no_broader_legal_or_book_claim: The 24 November 2025 guidelines are a dated instrument posted in January 2026. Category headings do not provide a named census. This review makes no broader current-law determination, use approval, textual version or service-book reception claim.

searches.method: Actual new grouped public-web discovery queries

query_batches.material_result: No current named universal census was authenticated from the returned results. Current Dicastery communications and older institutional speeches were leads for the parallel primary-source lane.
No full current named Annuario list was obtained from these bounded discovery results. Orthodox Albanian and unrelated Jubilee results were not Catholic classification evidence.
A 2026 print-edition catalogue lead and the official digital-service route were found. The presentation PDF's discovery URL failed live retrieval. No named subscriber contents were obtained.

The current official monthly index and dated presentation wrapper were acquired whole. The exact linked PDF form was tried and also returned HTTP 404. Cached search prose is excluded from acquired-source findings.

Returned retail/secondary edition leads did not provide original 2026 title, colophon or named Church section. The Vaticanum catalogue was acquired only as a locating lead. No primary publisher/library full-current-section delivery was authenticated in this bounded pass.

queries: eastern catholic churches list usccb Albanian
eastern catholic churches official 23 Albanian sui iuris Catholic Near East Welfare 2026
query_batches.material_result: USCCB regional and 2018 chart results, Orthodox dialogue material, secondary encyclopedias and social commentary were excluded as substitutes for a current authoritative universal named census. A Toronto baptism booklet lead at the official diocesan URL returned HTTP 404 and was not inspected. No omission in these search results is treated as evidence about Albanian classification.

searches.limit: The grouped results record material discovery outcomes, not a certified zero-hit search for each query or an exhaustive web census. No paid/subscriber directory contents, account or correspondence was sought.
searches.query_syntax_limit: Actual first-batch site.domain text is preserved exactly; it is not relabelled as a site:-restricted or certified zero-hit search.

searches.method: Parallel official-domain discovery, complete offered acquisitions, bounded text-layer search and identified original-page inspection
searches.query_boundary: Twenty discovery queries over official Dicastery/Holy See domains; returned results include old and irrelevant documents despite date terms. No claim of exhaustive web coverage or a negative canonical existence finding. Older 2010/2016 results were not repackaged as new evidence.
searches.limit: Text-layer/visible-text regex searches are reproducible discovery aids, not complete semantic absence proofs or whole-volume image inspection. Source-specific examined loci are stated for every delivery.
searches.unexamined: Authenticated/subscriber Annuario named directory; original 2026 print title, colophon, named section and notes; complete printed 2025 pastoral guide beyond its public extract; unvisited linked speeches; unqueried aliases and unindexed sources.

exact_external_input_needed: A publicly reachable or already-held authenticated complete named section of the latest Annuario Pontificio or current official digital directory, including its title/edition or capture date, category headings, all named Eastern Church entries, definitions and relevant footnotes. A 2026 print source must remain dated to that edition; later material changes must be checked separately before claiming an October 2026 state.

Alternatively, a dated public Dicastery or Central Statistics Office enumeration/clarification with the same named scope and Albanian distinction. No purchase, new subscription, credential transfer or external contact is requested by this research record.
